description: Generate a shareable link for a roadmap. The roadmap source is encoded into the URL fragment (client-side; no upload, no account, no network call) and opens in the free Nowline web app (free.nowline.io/open), where anyone with the link can view it and export to PDF/PNG/SVG. Prefer `render` to show a roadmap in chat — that is the default. Use `share` only when the user explicitly asks for a link to open, send, or export elsewhere.

path.description: Real local filesystem path to the .nowline file (e.g. /Users/name/Desktop/foo.nowline). Never pass a virtual or sandbox path such as /mnt/user-data/… — those do not exist on the host filesystem. Pass `source` instead.

name: share
